contracts.boundary: Merge the current main branch into v2, preserving both ignore rules, main copyright attribution, v2 license link, main badge, main instruction updates, and the upstream test assertion correction. Product routing code is unchanged.
contracts.assertions: The merge commit has the current v2 and main tips as parents and merges cleanly with main. The targeted resolver tests check the upstream assertion and executable resolution. Diff checks confirm no conflict markers or whitespace defects.

boundaryTest.name: throws when explicit env is not executable

fault.exception: Conflict resolution only; no production routing behavior changes. The target test exercises a real non-executable temporary binary rather than an injected production fault.
